title: 2025 HMMT February Guts Problem 30
statement:
Let \(a\) , \(b\) , and \(c\) be real numbers satisfying the system of equations

\[a\sqrt{1 + b^{2}} +b\sqrt{1 + a^{2}} = \frac{3}{4},\] \[b\sqrt{1 + c^{2}} +c\sqrt{1 + b^{2}} = \frac{5}{12},\mathrm{and}\] \[c\sqrt{1 + a^{2}} +a\sqrt{1 + c^{2}} = \frac{21}{20}.\]

Compute \(a\) .

solutions.text:
Recall that the functions \(\sinh (x) = \frac{e^{x} - e^{- x}}{2}\) and \(\cosh (x) = \frac{e^{- x} + e^{- x}}{2}\) satisfy the relation

\[\sinh (x + y) = \sinh (x)\cosh (y) + \cosh (x)\sinh (y) = \sinh (x)\sqrt{1 + \sinh (y)^{2}} +\sinh (y)\sqrt{1 + \sinh (x)^{2}}.\]

Since \(\sinh\) is surjective, we can perform the substitution \(a = \sinh (x)\) , \(b = \sinh (y)\) , and \(c = \sinh (z)\) , which turns the equations into

\[\sinh (x + y) = \frac{2 - \frac{1}{2}}{2},\] \[\sinh (y + z) = \frac{\frac{3}{2} - \frac{2}{3}}{2},\] \[\sinh (z + x) = \frac{\frac{5}{2} - \frac{2}{5}}{2}.\]

Thus, \(x + y = \log (2)\) , \(y + z = \log (3 / 2)\) , and \(z + x = \log (5 / 2)\) . Solving these equations gives \(x = \log (\sqrt{10 / 3})\) , so \(a = \frac{1}{2}\left(\sqrt{\frac{10}{3}} - \sqrt{\frac{3}{10}}\right) = \left[\frac{7}{2\sqrt{30}}\right]\)
